name: date-chip
title: Date chip
description: A due or target date that works out where it stands: the date while it is upcoming, Today, Tomorrow or In 2 days when it is close, the days late once it has passed, and Done with the close date. The glyph, the words and the tone change together, so the risk reads in grayscale, and screen readers hear the whole sentence (Overdue: due Wednesday, October 21, 3 days late). Plain for dense rows and board cards, a pill for property panels.
